messages:
Lina (AE): Fwd from Connectiva (large health system): they want to run a 2-week POC next month. Main asks: SCIM bulk import behavior, SAML assertion encryption (they require AES-256 + encrypted attributes), domain verification across 3 customer-owned domains, mapping their IdP roles to Redwood RBAC, and whether a Dedicated box is needed for SSO peaks. They also attached the security questionnaire.
Owen (SE): Copy. SCIM notes: bulk CSV import for initial 40k users, then incremental SCIM PATCH deltas (~1.5k/day). They care about atomic group membership sync so role changes are immediate. Question: do they need full SCIM v2 compliance with PATCH/PUT support?
Priya (Infra): We support SCIM v2 PATCH and also a bulk ingest pipeline for CSV with a background job that applies changes. For the POC we can accelerate the ingest window. Need sample CSV to test chunking/ordering.
Claire (Sec): On encrypted SAML assertions: we support assertion encryption using SP public cert. We can encrypt attributes and NameID. Confirm they want encrypted NameID + encrypted attributes. Also confirm digest algorithms and requested algorithms (RSA-OAEP, AES-GCM).
Lina (AE): They specified RSA-OAEP + AES256-GCM and want encrypted attributes including email and roles.
Owen (SE): That's fine. We will accept their SP metadata and configure x509 encryption. If they have multiple SP endpoints (one per region/domain) we prefer separate metadata for each; otherwise use a multi-entity configuration.
Jesse (PM): Domain proofing: they want automated DNS TXT verification for all three domains (app.customer.com, id.customer.com, admin.customer.com). Product doesn't yet support multi-domain auto-provisioning end-to-end, but manual TXT add + verification is fine for POC. We'll note automation for roadmap if customer needs it.
Claire (Sec): Also highlight: for healthcare we need to support CME (customer-managed encryption) for at-rest keys. Hosted supports CMK via KMS; Dedicated can support customer HSM. We'll need their KMS ARN and the expected key rotation policy.
Tom (Legal): They flagged SOC2 and DPA requirements in the questionnaire. We can provide our SOC2 report and standard DPA. Any special data residency asks?
Lina (AE): They prefer US-only data residency. Is that covered in hosted?
Priya (Infra): Hosted has region pins (US-East/West). For strict residency we can provision a region-restricted tenant. Dedicated/private is an option if they require isolated hardware.
Owen (SE): RBAC mapping: they want IdP group-to-role mapping and mapping of attributes to fine-grained perms. Proposed pattern: SCIM groups -> Redwood roles; SAML assertions -> transient role claims for session elevation. Example mapping:
```
IdP group: "connectiva_admins" -> Redwood role: "org.admin"
SAML attribute: roles: ["auditor"] -> grant "audit.read" permission scope for session
```
We should validate attribute casing and custom claim names in their metadata.
Claire (Sec): Session revocation: we offer a deprovisioning webhook and immediate token blacklist. Hosted best-effort propagation < 60s; Dedicated can have guaranteed propagation SLA. Important: if they have long-lived cookies in their SP, those remain until client clears them. Recommend short access TTL + refresh on reauth.
Lina (AE): Pricing question: Customer asked if Dedicated monthly commit could be <$10k for a small POC. Thoughts?
Jesse (PM): Dedicated minimums usually start higher. For a short POC we can do hosted with a paid trial boost. If they need Dedicated we'd need a commercial exception; discuss with sales ops.
Owen (SE): Performance numbers for decision: SAML handshakes ~5-15 qps, CSV bulk import sustained ~120 qps for 2-3h, SCIM delta bursts up to 60 qps. That maps to hosted with a short burst cap. Dedicated only if sustained > 250 qps for auth+provisioning.
Tom (Legal): Also they requested contractual language that we won't assume responsibility for domain verification if they use shared DNS providers. We'll include a clause clarifying customer responsibility to add TXT records for verification and timeline expectations.
Claire (Sec): Checklist of artifacts we need from customer: SP metadata (xml), example CSV (first 500 rows), KMS ARN if CMK, list of domains to verify, expected peak QPS window.
Priya (Infra): For private VPC POC estimate: ~10 business days to provision a networked environment with firewall rules and peering. Hosted with private endpoint is 48-72h.
Lina (AE): Can someone drop a short FAQ I can share with their security and infra teams?
Owen (SE): I'll write a 1-page FAQ with: SCIM rate limits + bulk import path, SAML encryption options, RBAC mapping examples, session revoke behavior, and recommended configs. I'll post it here by EOD.
Priya (Infra): I'll prepare the VPC checklist and the hosted-region pin steps.
infra-bot: Note: "poc-hosted-boost" scheduled for staging in 3h; will auto-scale SCIM pipeline for 4h window. Reply "cancel" to abort.
Tom (Legal): I'll prepare DPA + SOC2 delivery and draft the domain verification clause.
Lina (AE): Thanks team 44d I'll compile and send to Connectiva. If they sign up for Dedicated we'll get commercial + infra leads engaged.
Owen (SE): One last: ask them if they need SCIM delta ordering guarantees (we don't offer per-tenant strong ordering beyond best-effort). If they need strict ordering we can discuss compensating idempotency keys.
Lina (AE): Good point 44d I'll ask.
